ugc.title: What Are AI UGC Ads?
paras: AI UGC is a recommendation that sounds like someone who uses the product. An AI actor carries the line, so a DTC brand can talk about a new serum without booking an influencer for that week.
A jar that already has a listing can become a clip shaped like a phone video. You tell the video agent who the ad is for, and a template keeps that shape familiar to people scrolling the feed.
Hold a night cream the way a friend would. The ad then sits beside ordinary posts, and a glossy studio spot is a different job.

faq.q: Why does a creator-style ad hold attention?
faq.a: People stop for a recommendation, and this format is a recommendation. A DTC brand can open on one annoyance the buyer already has, like a lid that leaks in a bag, and let the product answer it. A second opening can come from that same note, with no one new to hire.

faq.q: What are people referring to when they say AI UGC?
faq.a: A product ad that sounds like a person who uses the item, delivered by an AI actor. A SaaS team can show one screen while someone talks through it, and that week does not need a film crew.

faq.q: What does Starter include for making ads?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month and includes 200 credits. A photo is 24 credits. A 6-second clip is 24, a 10-second clip is 40, 15 seconds is 60, and 30 seconds is 120. You see that cost before you generate.

faq.q: When is the file ready for me to download?
faq.a: After the render completes. Download the file from the editor and review the line before posting.

faq.q: What do I actually do to put an AI actor in an ad?
faq.a: Start with the product page or photo, choose an AI actor, approve the script, and export the clip. Change the line in the editor if it does not fit the product.

faq.q: Where do the AI actors for these ads come from?
faq.a: From the library on this account. Pick an adult face that fits the brand. A payroll app and a snack label should not use the same person.

faq.q: I only have the address of the product page. Can I start there?
faq.a: Yes. A public page for a standing desk already holds the photo and the product name, and that can open the ad. Add a note if the buyer works from a home office rather than a warehouse.

faq.q: Do I need a signed release before I run an AI actor ad?
faq.a: No. The AI actor and stock voice are cleared for commercial ads, so no signed release is needed for them. You still need rights to the bottle photo and any voice sample you upload.

faq.q: What can I still change after the clip exists?
faq.a: You can edit the price or presenter, then render a new version. Each new render spends credits, shown before you confirm.

faq.q: How does an AI actor ad differ from a customer video?
faq.a: An AI actor ad uses a generated presenter instead of a customer filming on a phone. It gives the brand another way to test a product line when nobody is free to record.

faq.q: Should I use an AI actor or hire a person?
faq.a: Use an AI actor for fast tests, and hire a person when the ad depends on a specific founder or performer. A skincare label can use an AI actor for a draft and save the founder for a launch film.

faq.q: Can I create AI UGC ads in another language?
faq.a: Yes. A brand selling the same charger in Spain and in Korea writes two lines and picks a voice for each. A cloned voice is only an option when you have rights to the sample.

faq.q: How do I get an AI UGC ad into a campaign?
faq.a: Download the finished file and upload it to TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, or Google Ads like any video your team made.

faq.q: Our promotion starts soon. Where do we take the ad?
faq.a: Bring the product page, or a script you already trust, and download the file when the render completes. If you want someone here to carry the job, email support@aivideosugc.com about done-for-you work. You still approve the line before it posts.

faq.q: Can an AI actor use a voice we already recorded?
faq.a: Yes, if you own that recording. A founder who taped a short hello can have an AI actor use it on the next product clip. Do not upload anyone else's voice.

faq.q: Can we publish UGC-style ads with no creator on contract?
faq.a: Yes. A DTC brand can post from the listing photo and an AI actor, and that cut does not need a creator on contract.

faq.q: Can the ad be a testimonial that belongs on TikTok?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can deliver a testimonial-style product line in a vertical format. Start from the photo already on the product page and download the clip with the line on screen.

faq.q: What should a DTC brand look for in an AI UGC tool?
faq.a: Look for a tool that finishes the ad in one place instead of a stack of separate apps. AIVideosUGC is built for DTC brands, SaaS teams, and agencies. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: What photo should I upload?
faq.a: Use a clear photo of the product you sell, with the whole item in frame. A phone photo on a plain background is enough. Upload only photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Are the people in these clips buyers?
faq.a: No. They are AI actors. Run the clip as your ad, and follow each platform's rules for labeling AI. Do not present the clip as a review written by someone who bought the product.
